name: Sueño
source:
Sueño is a furry Visual Novel focusing on the struggles of a group of friends and their fear of what's to come. Follow the journey of a grey wolf as he tries to understand the world around him with his closest friends. 

[From [url=https://sometimes9.itch.io/sueno]Itch.io[/url]]
